plan.title: SHG Loan Repayment & Purpose Analysis
plan.subtitle: Overview of loan repayment status, overdue amounts, and distribution by purpose

panels.title: Total Amount Repaid
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Amount Repaid (Rs)") AS total_repaid FROM "shg_loan_register" WHERE "Repayment Status" != 'Overdue'

panels.title: Overdue Loan Count
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "shg_loan_register" WHERE "Repayment Status" = 'Overdue'

panels.title: Loans by Repayment Status
panels.sql: SELECT "Repayment Status" AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Loan Amount by Purpose
panels.sql: SELECT "Purpose" AS purpose, SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_amount FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top Overdue Loans by Amount
panels.sql: SELECT "Loan ID", "Block", "Purpose", "Loan Amount (Rs)", "Amount Repaid (Rs)" FROM "shg_loan_register" WHERE "Repayment Status" = 'Overdue' ORDER BY "Loan Amount (Rs)" DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative:
The SHG loan portfolio currently consists of {{p1}} total loans. Of these, {{p3}} loans are marked as overdue, indicating a need for closer monitoring.

In terms of financial recovery, the total amount repaid stands at {{p2}} Rs. This figure represents the cumulative sum of repayments from loans that are not in an overdue state.

The distribution of loans across different purposes reveals where capital is being directed. The bar chart highlights which sectors receive the highest funding volume.

Finally, the table lists the top 10 overdue loans by principal amount, providing specific details on the blocks and purposes associated with the highest risk exposures.
